controlPlaneProbes: ls crates/loom-facade/src/bin/*.rs crates/loom-scaffold/src/bin/*.rs crates/loom-vector-ruvector/src/bin/*.rs 2>&1 | head -15 || true

buildStep.cmd: echo '== facade =='; curl -s --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8084/health || echo 'FACADE UNREACHABLE'; echo; echo '== ontology-mcp =='; (cd app/ontology-mcp && npm ci --ignore-scripts 2>&1 | tail -5) || echo 'NPM CI FAILED'

evaluatorEntrypoints.graph: curl -s --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8084/health | cargo run -q -p loom-facade --bin graph-check || echo 'GRAPH EVALUATOR FAILED'
evaluatorEntrypoints.confidence: curl -s --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8084/health | cargo run -q -p loom-facade --bin confidence-check || echo 'CONFIDENCE EVALUATOR FAILED'
evaluatorEntrypoints.generation: curl -s --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8084/health | cargo run -q -p loom-facade --bin generation-check || echo 'GENERATION EVALUATOR FAILED'
